result.summary: Found several visual bugs: overlapping/garbled text on a restaurant card, truncated restaurant names, and cut-off category chips indicating layout overflow issues.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, delivery time text overlaps and collides with other copy, appearing as garbled text like '25-3Ddelivery · Ramen' instead of a clean '25-30 min delivery · Ramen'.
issues.suggestion: Fix text layering/positioning so delivery time, fee, and cuisine labels do not overlap; ensure proper spacing and z-order on the card.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with no ellipsis or full name visible in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping, use ellipsis with tooltip/full name on tap, or widen/adjust card layout so names are fully readable.

issues.description: Category filter chips row is cut off on the right (partial 'Healthy' chip and next chip clipped), suggesting horizontal overflow without clear affordance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure chips scroll horizontally with padding/fade, or wrap/reflow so all categories are fully visible and tappable.

issues.description: Bottom pizza card is partially cut off by the tab bar, hiding the restaurant name and details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding so the last card clears the fixed navigation bar when scrolled into view.
